data.translation_en: HAVE WE NOT opened up thy heart,

data.translation_aya_text: dan Kami pun telah menurunkan bebanmu darimu,
data.translation_en: and lifted from thee the burden
that had weighed so heavily on thy back?
And [have We not] raised thee high in dignity?

data.translation_aya_text: Maka sesungguhnya beserta kesulitan ada kemudahan,
data.translation_en: And, behold, with every hardship comes ease:

data.translation_aya_text: sesungguhnya beserta kesulitan itu ada kemudahan.
data.translation_en: verily, with every hardship comes ease!

data.translation_aya_text: Maka apabila engkau telah selesai (dari sesuatu urusan), tetaplah bekerja keras (untuk urusan yang lain),
data.translation_en: Hence, when thou art freed [from distress], remain steadfast,

data.translation_aya_text: dan hanya kepada Tuhanmulah engkau berharap.
data.translation_en: and unto thy Sustainer turn with love.
